Lissandra.laning: Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid the piercing path of Lissandra Q Ice Shard. When health has been reduced, don’t recklessly push with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; recover with Q Transfusion, then clear the wave.
Lissandra.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage and can lock you down with a root and stun for follow-up damage, so get magic resistance and tenacity.
Lissandra.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her and land it. Follow with empowered Q Transfusion, then dodge the counterattack’s crowd control with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you. E Tides of Blood can be blocked through a dense minion wave, so find a clear angle to cast it.
Lissandra.escape: The moment after Lissandra uses Lissandra E Glacial Path is an opportunity to close the distance, and it’s a good time to trade if Lissandra W Ring of Frost is down too. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, she can counterattack with a stun or self-stasis, so don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool too early.
Lissandra.fight: Immediately after Lissandra W Ring of Frost is used on the wave or misses, close the distance and trade. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version, then slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land empowered Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge Lissandra’s crowd control instead of using it first.
Lissandra.phase: As your items stack up, you grow stronger, so in the mid to late game focus on hitting several champions in teamfights rather than getting lane kills.
Lissandra.teamfight: Engage with your team when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready and you’ve confirmed whether Lissandra E Glacial Path has been used. Hit several clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land it alongside empowered Q Transfusion. Dodge Lissandra’s crowd control and the enemies’ counterattack with W Sanguine Pool when they come in. Target clustered enemies instead of chasing just one.
Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting a minion, so don’t stand in a line with your allied minions. Keep your distance because you can be hit in succession by the root from Lissandra W Ring of Frost and the stun from Lissandra R Frozen Tomb; use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the crowd control reaches you. If Lissandra can cast R Frozen Tomb on herself, spread out your damage until her stasis ends.

Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so deny her advantages and build armor. Qiyana is relatively weaker late game while Vladimir grows stronger as he gets items, so look for fights with your team.
Qiyana.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana deals mostly physical damage and Vladimir has low armor, so build armor first. If Qiyana keeps diving, get Zhonya's Hourglass early to cover the long cooldown of Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Qiyana.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. If Qiyana stays in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply a slow, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If minions are packed between you, Vladimir E Tides of Blood won’t reach Qiyana, so adjust your position. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to absorb the counterattack.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t engage just because Qiyana W Terrashape is down. Counterattack after she has also used Qiyana E Audacity, especially before it comes back up. If you dodge Qiyana’s crowd control with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, that moment is your chance to trade.
Qiyana.fight: Keep your distance while Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity are available. If Qiyana uses an engage ability and remains in front of you, let her combo pass, then counterattack. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first in a routine trade; use it just before Qiyana’s crowd control hits.
Qiyana.laning: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to time an empowered Q, but don’t give Qiyana room to engage.
Qiyana.teamfight: Position away from walls and narrow passages to reduce the chance of several allies getting caught by Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent. Hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague as your team engages, then go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and deal damage with E and the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when Qiyana’s counterattacks converge, and aim for grouped enemies instead of chasing one target.
Qiyana.watch: Depending on the element, Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal helps her engage with a root or stealth. If she approaches with the river element, move out of range; if she disappears with the brush element, move into allied vision. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent stuns and deals heavy damage when it hits terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid the river and narrow passages.

Ahri.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Most of Ahri's damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. However, the true damage Ahri Q Orb of Deception deals on its return cannot be reduced by magic resistance.
Ahri.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it. When you have an angle to hit Ahri, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, fire it to slow her, then land your empowered Q. E can be blocked by minions, so don’t fire it through the wave.
Ahri.escape: If Ahri E Charm is also down, you have a good window to close in, but account for Ahri W Fox-Fire’s movement speed boost, which can create distance.
Ahri.fight: The moment Ahri E Charm is down is your chance to close in. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it. When Ahri enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land your empowered Q. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it for Ahri’s retaliation.
Ahri.laning: Last-hit the incoming wave near your turret with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Ahri.phase: In the mid and late game, look for teamfights where Vladimir grows stronger as he builds items.
Ahri.teamfight: When the enemy team groups up, hit multiple targets with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies the moment they engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land your empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E. Dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge on you. Immediately after dodging Ahri E Charm, you have a chance to close in on her.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can take the full follow-up damage, so dodge it from behind minions. Just before Charm connects, clear it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Ahri Q Orb of Deception also hits on its way back, so move out of its return path even after dodging the first pass.

Akshan.teamfight: Hit multiple targets, including Akshan, with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in as your allies engage. Charge E Tides of Blood, then land it with empowered Q Transfusion. Use W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in. If Akshan’s Scoundrel mark is on you, don’t face him alone; fight outside Akshan’s finishing range.
Akshan.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. Akshan’s main damage is physical, and Vladimir has relatively low armor, so build armor first.
Akshan.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered state. Once Akshan E Heroic Swing is down and Akshan enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit him with the slow, then land your empowered Q. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it to dodge Akshan’s retaliation.
Akshan.escape: Akshan E Heroic Swing is his mobility tool, so close the gap right after he uses it. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has a long cooldown, so don’t use it first; save it for when the counterattack comes in.
Akshan.fight: Right after you force Akshan to use E Heroic Swing is your chance to close the gap. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it. When Akshan enters range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land your empowered Q.
Akshan.phase: In the mid and late game, clear the wave, then get vision or group with your team, and deal area damage in teamfights.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang gains range as it hits minions, so even from behind the wave, dodge both its outgoing and returning paths. Akshan R Comeuppance deals more damage based on your missing health, so if it targets you while your health is low, get behind terrain to block the shots.

AurelionSol.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when the enemy enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood so it slows them, and hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Minions can block Tides of Blood before it reaches Aurelion Sol, so don’t fire through the wave. In a fight, hit with Vladimir R Hemoplague first, then go in with your allies while its damage amplification remains.
AurelionSol.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Since Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, don’t rely on stacking health alone.
AurelionSol.escape: The moment Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down is your window to close the gap. Avoid crowd control from Aurelion Sol E Singularity and Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend, and engage while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. Use Pool just before enemy crowd control hits; don’t spend it as soon as you start trading.
AurelionSol.fight: The moment Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is used is your chance to close the gap, but first consider the risk of getting caught if Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is unavailable.
AurelionSol.laning: Don’t let Aurelion Sol keep hitting you with Q Breath of Light and stacking Stardust; catch the pushed wave near your turret. If your health is low, don’t recklessly push the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol’s Stardust stacks permanently, so he becomes harder to take down using the same approach toward the late game.
AurelionSol.teamfight: Hit multiple clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and charged E, then use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge when the counterattack comes in. Before engaging, spread out so your allies don’t all get hit by the empowered Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on your maximum health, and repeatedly hitting the same target deals bonus damage and grants Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its line. If you enter Aurelion Sol E Singularity, walk out immediately, and avoid even its edge when your health is low because you could be executed. Once Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend is empowered, spread out from your allies so you don’t all get hit by the area knock-up.

Cassiopeia.watch: If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more while you're poisoned, so move out of range and re-engage after the poison ends. When you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze's cast animation, turn away to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If the enemy team also relies on healing to survive, fit Morellonomicon in between your core items.
Cassiopeia.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. Once Cassiopeia's poison ends and she's in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked by the minions in front, so don't cast it through the wave.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no skill that lets her create distance on her own, so the moment after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to engage. If you risk taking Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze head-on, turn away during its cast animation. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until just before her counterattack reaches you.
Cassiopeia.fight: Avoid long fights early, and trade briefly after the poison from Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast ends. Look for a chance to close the distance right after Cassiopeia uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. Don't spend Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; use it to dodge her counterattack.
Cassiopeia.laning: Take pushed waves near your turret. When health has been lost, don’t force a push with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Cassiopeia.phase: Cassiopeia is strong later if she can freely deal sustained damage, so don't face her for long.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: Track Cassiopeia's path with vision, and look to engage right after she uses Cassiopeia W Miasma elsewhere. As your allies engage, cover several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge, and deal area damage where enemies overlap instead of chasing just one.

Anivia.escape: Anivia has no mobility, so the moment Anivia Q Flash Frost is down is your chance to close in. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Anivia Q Flash Frost hits; don’t spend it to start a trade. Save Flash if Anivia W Crystallize could separate you from your allies during your engage.
Anivia.fight: Close the gap after dodging Anivia Q Flash Frost or clearing it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Prepare empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions, then charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, slow her, and land your empowered Q. If Anivia P Rebirth is available, don’t force a solo kill; pressure her with your allies.
Anivia.build: Survive Anivia’s magic damage early with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads. Movement speed to escape the slows from Anivia Q Flash Frost and Anivia R Glacial Storm is also important.
Anivia.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered state. When Anivia enters range and you’ve dodged Anivia Q Flash Frost, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then follow with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked by minions in the wave, so find a clear path before firing.
Anivia.laning: Vladimir E Tides of Blood costs health, so don’t spam it to farm when health has been lost.
Anivia.phase: In the mid and late game, use Vladimir’s area damage, which grows as he builds items, in teamfights.
Anivia.teamfight: Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape in narrow jungle paths, so fight in open areas whenever possible. When the enemy team groups up, hit multiple targets with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E, then absorb the counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when it comes in.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost stuns when it detonates, and Anivia E Frostbite deals much more damage to chilled targets. Don’t try to dodge the explosion with a sidestep alone; absorb it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it connects. Leave areas grown by Anivia R Glacial Storm immediately, and keep your distance in narrow paths where Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape.

Akali.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Akali’s main damage is magic, and Vladimir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If you’re worried about the opening Akali’s dive creates while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is unavailable, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier. Add penetration against Akali’s high magic resistance.
Akali.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when Akali comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood and fire it to slow her. Follow with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, and use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to absorb Akali’s counterattack. Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked by the minions in front, so don’t fire it through the wave.
Akali.escape: If you dodged the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip and Akali R Perfect Execution is still down, you have a chance to trade. Check whether Akali W Twilight Shroud is also down to reduce the chance she escapes with her remaining mobility. If your Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is unavailable, don’t go deep; you’ll have little to withstand Akali’s re-engage.
Akali.fight: Don’t go deep just because one of Akali W Twilight Shroud, Akali E Shuriken Flip, or Akali R Perfect Execution is down. In particular, trade back when Akali comes out of the shroud to attack, before Akali R Perfect Execution is back up. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool for an early trade; save it for Akali’s engage and retaliation.
Akali.laning: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered timing. When Akali approaches, hit her with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. When health has been lost, don’t recklessly push the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Akali.teamfight: When the enemy team groups up, hit multiple targets with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in as your allies engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when Akali engages or other counterattacks converge. Hit clustered enemies together for area damage and healing instead of chasing one target.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. Once marked, you can’t escape the second dash by running, so use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool if the shuriken is about to hit. You can’t dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution on foot, and its second hit deals more damage based on your missing health, so save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool for after Akali closes in.

Ambessa.build: Ambessa’s damage is mainly physical, and Vladimir has low armor, so buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. If Ambessa is diving onto Vladimir, get Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. If the enemy team also sustains through healing, fit Morellonomicon between core items.
Ambessa.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered timing. After Ambessa W Repudiation’s windup ends and Ambessa has spent her abilities, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Ambessa’s counterattack hits; you can also use it while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood.
Ambessa.escape: The moment Ambessa has spent her abilities and all Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges is your chance to go in. Engage while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available, before you get hit by the crowd control from Ambessa E Lacerate or Ambessa R Public Execution.
Ambessa.fight: Trade right after Ambessa has spent her abilities and Ambessa P Drakehound's Step charges. Stop attacking and leave the area during Ambessa W Repudiation’s windup, then look for another opening. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; use it just before Ambessa’s crowd control hits or when counterattacks converge.
Ambessa.laning: In the early game, last-hit with Vladimir Q Transfusion near your turret and grow without dying. Ambessa can close the gap with one ability, so don’t stay far up the lane while her abilities are available. When health has been lost, don’t recklessly push the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Ambessa.phase: In the late game, use Vladimir’s grown area damage in teamfights.
Ambessa.teamfight: As your allies go in, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and enter with them while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in. Position so your team’s backline isn’t at the end of Ambessa R Public Execution’s line, and target clustered enemies rather than a single opponent.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup of Ambessa W Repudiation, don’t attack; walk out of range. The edges of Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam are dangerous, so dodge the first hit, and if it’s hard to avoid, move close to her. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, immediately use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool so you can dodge the follow-up Q. Ambessa R Public Execution targets the farthest champion in a straight line, so when facing her, don’t stand in a straight line between Ambessa and your team’s backline.

Annie.build: In the early game, survive first with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads. Annie’s damage is mostly magic, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Annie.combo: In lane, use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when Annie goes in, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her and land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In teamfights, hit multiple targets with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land it together with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in.
Annie.escape: Annie has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment Annie P Pyromania’s stun is used is your chance to close in.
Annie.fight: Pressure Annie after she uses her stun and before she prepares it again. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it. When Annie enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you need to dodge Annie’s counterattack.
Annie.laning: When health has been lost, pushing the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood makes the situation more dangerous, so heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion. Vladimir E Tides of Blood may not reach Annie through the wave, so check your position before using it.
Annie.phase: Afterward, clear the wave and group with your team, dealing area damage in teamfights as you build items.
Annie.teamfight: If Annie is missing or Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, stand apart from your allies so you don’t all get hit by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers. Use Vladimir R Hemoplague when multiple enemies group up and go in with your allies. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge the counterattack, and deal area damage to clustered enemies instead of chasing one target.
Annie.watch: When Annie P Pyromania’s stun is ready, don’t enter Annie’s ability range. Spread out so multiple allies don’t get hit by the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, and keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers.

Aurora.build: In the early game, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads. Aurora’s main damage is magic, and Vladimir has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. Aurora P Spirit Abjuration deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t try to survive by stacking health alone.
Aurora.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when Aurora gets close, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood and fire it to slow her, followed by empowered Q. The wave can block E, so don’t fire through minions. In teamfights, hit multiple targets with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in while charging E. Land empowered Q and E, then use W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in.
Aurora.escape: Aurora having used both W Across the Veil and E The Weirding is your window to engage. Check that Aurora R Between Worlds is still down, too, and go in while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. If Aurora used her mobility to engage but didn’t get a takedown, look for the moment when she can’t follow up with another leap.
Aurora.fight: Early on, protect your health and farm with Q instead of forcing a kill. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered timing. When Aurora enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Q. If Aurora W Across the Veil makes her disappear, save your targeted abilities and wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.laning: If you’re below half health while afflicted by Aurora Q Twofold Hex, don’t continue trading; retreat.
Aurora.phase: In the mid and late game, as your items build up, use Vladimir’s area damage and healing in teamfights.
Aurora.teamfight: Hit multiple enemies, including Aurora, with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies as they engage. If Aurora disappears with W Across the Veil, don’t waste Vladimir Q Transfusion; wait for her to reappear. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in, and retreat with low-health allies so Aurora can’t reset her leap with a takedown.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, move out of the curse’s return path, and if your health is low, retreat before it returns. When Aurora R Between Worlds opens, leaving the area slows you, so decide whether to escape before it appears or fight inside. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before an incoming Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits.

Azir.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Azir deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Azir.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Azir's soldiers are stationary and Azir is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood and apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Azir's counterattack reaches you.
Azir.escape: Right after Azir E Shifting Sands is used is your window to engage. If Azir places a soldier near a wall, he can use Azir E Shifting Sands toward it, so keep his escape route in mind when you dive in. If Azir R Emperor's Divide is still available, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the knockback reaches you.
Azir.fight: The window to approach is when Azir W Arise! soldiers are stationary and before Azir recasts Azir Q Conquering Sands. Go around the side or behind a soldier, get onto Azir, and deal a quick burst of damage. Close the distance right after Azir E Shifting Sands is used. Don't use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it to dodge Azir's counterattack.
Azir.laning: Look to trade only when Azir's soldiers are gone or mana has been spent. When health has been lost, heal with Vladimir Q Transfusion, then clear the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked by minions if you cast it through the wave.
Azir.phase: Both champions get stronger later, so avoid fights where Azir's soldiers can hit you for a long time and deal your damage in short bursts during teamfights.
Azir.teamfight: Engage from multiple directions in a wide area so Azir R Emperor's Divide doesn't knock your allies back together. When the enemy team is grouped, hit several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague. As your allies engage, go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, and land it together with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Dodge when Azir's counterattacks converge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, and target overlapping enemies instead of chasing just one.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the line of Azir W Arise! soldiers, and keep your distance after Azir moves them with Azir Q Conquering Sands. Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock Vladimir away when he dives in, so dodge it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you. Avoid diving in through narrow passages, where the remaining soldier wall can block your allies too.

Corki.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first against Corki's main damage, but also consider health because resistances don't work against the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. Once Corki W Valkyrie is used and Corki is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Corki's counterattack reaches you.
Corki.escape: Right after Corki uses Corki W Valkyrie is your chance to close the distance. If Corki W Valkyrie is still available, he can escape over terrain if you engage too aggressively, so don't rush in then.
Corki.fight: Close the distance right after Corki W Valkyrie is used. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast, then slow Corki with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Move to the side to avoid the frontal area of Corki E Gatling Gun, and save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge his counterattack.
Corki.laning: If Corki pushes the wave, take it near your turret. After a loss of health, heal with Vladimir Q Transfusion before forcing a push with Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Corki R Missile Barrage can hit you even behind minions, so watch its range and repeated launches.
Corki.phase: Corki can pressure you with Corki R Missile Barrage from a safe position once he has items, so don't let him farm comfortably.
Corki.teamfight: When the enemy team is grouped, cover several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies' engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, land it together with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, and dodge when counterattacks converge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage can hit the surrounding area even when you're behind minions, so move out of range and reposition especially to avoid repeatedly getting hit by the third missile. Clear projectiles that are hard to dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before they reach you, but don't use it first given its long cooldown. If Corki E Gatling Gun hits you, your resistances are reduced, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him.

Diana.build: Diana deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so first survive with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If you bring Zhonya's Hourglass forward to deal with Diana's dive, it can cover the gap in Vladimir W Sanguine Pool's availability.
Diana.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered third cast. When the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone and Diana is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood and apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Diana's counterattack reaches you.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with Diana E Lunar Rush without the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, she has no way to re-engage during that window. Slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and counterattack with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If you've been hit by the mark from Diana Q Crescent Strike, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance.
Diana.fight: Trade after the shield from Diana W Pale Cascade is gone. If you've dodged Diana Q Crescent Strike and Diana E Lunar Rush is down, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If you've been marked and Diana E Lunar Rush can be used again, create distance instead of trying to hold her there.
Diana.laning: Prioritize CS early, using Vladimir Q Transfusion to last-hit and heal. After a loss of health, heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion before pushing the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood.
Diana.teamfight: Spread out from your allies based on Diana's engage angle and secure vision on the flanks so several allies aren't pulled in together by Diana R Moonfall. When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready, cover several grouped enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and dive in as your allies engage. Go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then dodge when counterattacks converge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Diana.watch: Dodge Diana Q Crescent Strike by stepping to the side, since it curves as it flies. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush's cooldown may reset, so create distance. Dodge Diana R Moonfall with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it pulls you in, and don't fight in close range until the orbs and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear.

Ekko.build: Ekko deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Against an explosive champion who dives in like Ekko, bring Zhonya's Hourglass forward and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Ekko.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Ekko is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Dodge Ekko's counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you.
Ekko.escape: Right after Ekko E Phase Dive has been fully spent, one of his mobility abilities is down, but don't keep chasing if Ekko R Chronobreak is still available. Commit when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and R are down, and avoid W's stun area.
Ekko.fight: Don't force a kill early. Protect your health by avoiding Ekko W Parallel Convergence's area. Look to fight when Ekko R Chronobreak is down, and don't chase an Ekko deep if his afterimage shows that R is ready, even if he's low on health.
Ekko.phase: Use the moment Ekko R Chronobreak is down as an opportunity to fight in the mid to late game.
Ekko.teamfight: Cover several enemies, including Ekko, with Vladimir R Hemoplague, and go in with your allies' engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood, and use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge. If Ekko has used both W and R, look to continue the fight.
Ekko.watch: When you see the tell for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave its area to avoid the stun and shield. Step out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before an unavoidable stun reaches you.

Fizz.build: Fizz deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Fizz is diving onto Vladimir, bring Zhonya's Hourglass forward and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Fizz.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. Once Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down and Fizz is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Fizz's counterattack reaches you.
Fizz.escape: The window to engage is before Fizz E Playful / Trickster comes back up. If only Fizz Q Urchin Strike is down, he can still escape with E, so engage after confirming E is down. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters has attached to you, prioritize moving away from your allies over engaging.
Fizz.fight: Look for a chance to counterattack right after Fizz E Playful / Trickster has been fully spent. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast, and when Fizz is in range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you need to dodge Fizz's counterattack.
Fizz.laning: Look to trade when Fizz fails to secure a last-hit with W Seastone Trident and it goes on its full cooldown, or right after he uses Fizz E Playful / Trickster.
Fizz.phase: Vladimir gets stronger as he builds items, so deal area damage in teamfights in the mid to late game.
Fizz.teamfight: Stand close to your allies to make Fizz use Fizz E Playful / Trickster first, then attack together once it's down. Cover several grouped enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in as your allies engage while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge, and if the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.watch: If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts. Fizz uses Fizz Q Urchin Strike to dive in as the shark knocks you up, so if Fizz R Chum the Waters is about to hit you, dodge it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.

Galio.build: Galio deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Be careful about building a lot of health alone, since Galio Q Winds of War deals damage based on your maximum health.
Galio.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Galio is in range and you can avoid his crowd control, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply its slow, then use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked by the minions in front, so don't cast it through a dense wave.
Galio.escape: Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Galio E Justice Punch or Galio W Shield of Durand reaches you to avoid the crowd control. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has a long cooldown, so don't use it first in a normal trade. When engaging, don't assume Galio E Justice Punch being down is enough; look for a window when his other mobility and crowd control are down, especially before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back up.
Galio.fight: Keep your distance early and don't let Galio engage. When Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don't unload your damage; back away. After Galio's crowd control is down, use the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion you've prepared on a minion to trade.
Galio.laning: Grow near your turret early by last-hitting with Vladimir Q Transfusion. Vladimir E Tides of Blood costs health, so don't use it recklessly to push the wave when your health is low. If Galio uses his abilities to clear the wave and has spent mana, push the lane to limit his chance to influence other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.phase: Make the most of Vladimir's strength as his items stack up during mid to late game teamfights.
Galio.teamfight: While Galio R Hero's Entrance is ready, don't start a small fight with Galio's team in another lane. In teamfights, dodge the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance. When the enemy team is grouped, cover several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your allies' engage. Go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, land it together with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, and dodge the moment counterattacks converge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Galio.watch: Galio Q Winds of War leaves percentage-of-maximum-health damage over time where its gusts overlap, so move out of that area. When Galio W Shield of Durand is charging, don't unload your damage; move outside its taunt range. If you see the windup where Galio E Justice Punch steps back, dodge the knockup. If you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance, move out of the area immediately.

Hwei.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Hwei deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize building magic resistance. Health also boosts Vladimir's offensive power through Vladimir P Crimson Pact, but account for the maximum-health-based damage from Hwei Q Subject: Disaster.
Hwei.combo: In lane, use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice, then charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood from an angle where minions won't block it, apply its slow, and use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In a fight where several enemies are grouped, hit them first with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and hit them with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Just before Hwei's counterattack reaches you, dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, which you can cast even while charging.
Hwei.escape: Engage right after Hwei E Subject: Torment has been spent. Hwei has no mobility ability, so once you've closed the distance, look for a chance to hit him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood's slow and empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Hwei.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on a minion twice to prepare an empowered cast. Then, when Hwei is in range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and use empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Right after Hwei uses Hwei E Subject: Torment to poke or clear the wave, you have a chance to close the distance. Don't spend Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; use it to dodge Hwei's counterattack.
Hwei.laning: If Hwei hits you with the first spell, move to break his combo instead of standing still to heal.
Hwei.phase: In late-game teamfights, use the scaled-up Vladimir's area damage and healing on multiple champions.
Hwei.teamfight: Don't force your way through a narrow passage that Hwei has controlled with a zone or eye; take a wide route to engage. Dive in when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down and Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready. Use W to dodge when counterattacks converge.
Hwei.watch: If you're caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's root or pull, you're likely to take the follow-up attacks too, so dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you. If the first spell hits, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster also deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't stay in its telegraphed area.

Irelia.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Vladimir has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If the enemy team has a burst champion who can dive onto Vladimir, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier as well.
Irelia.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Irelia enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In a dense minion wave, Vladimir E Tides of Blood can be blocked, so don’t cast it through the wave.
Irelia.escape: Right after you force Irelia to use Q Bladesurge is an opportunity to close the distance. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, but don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first for a trade because it has a long cooldown.
Irelia.fight: Keep your distance when Irelia can dash in through a low-health minion. For trades, prime Vladimir Q Transfusion, then slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and follow with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet.
Irelia.laning: Don’t leave a low-health minion between you and Irelia, and take a step back when minions are about to die. After a loss of health, recover with Vladimir Q Transfusion, then use Vladimir E Tides of Blood to clear the wave.
Irelia.phase: In the mid to late game, clear the lane and group up to deal area damage in teamfights.
Irelia.teamfight: Focus Irelia first, since Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet threaten multiple champions. When the enemy team is grouped, hit several champions with Vladimir R Hemoplague. As your team engages, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood while going in. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the distance, so back away when minions are about to die. Dodge the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it lands. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Karma’s main damage is magic, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Karma.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Karma comes in, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply a slow, then land the empowered Q. In teamfights, hit several champions with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in while charging E. Land empowered Q and E, then dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when counterattacks converge.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, you have an opportunity to close the distance. If the tether connects, create distance to break it before it roots you. Engage after the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E Inspire is gone.
Karma.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Karma enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land the empowered Q. Delay your engage if Karma W Focused Resolve is available or if the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E Inspire is active.
Karma.laning: Repeatedly taking Karma’s abilities gives her more opportunities to use R Mantra, so reposition behind minions or outside her range.
Karma.teamfight: Bait out Karma W Focused Resolve, then time your engage with your team’s after the shield from Karma R Mantra empowered E Inspire is gone.
Karma.watch: The area slow from Karma Q Inner Flame makes it hard to create distance. If you’re hit by the fire zone from Karma R Mantra empowered Q, leave the circle before it explodes. If Karma W Focused Resolve connects, create distance to break the tether before it roots you. If you can’t avoid the root, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it lands.

Kassadin.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Kassadin deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance. If Kassadin repeatedly dives in to deal burst damage, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Kassadin.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is down and he enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow him, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Kassadin’s counterattack reaches you.
Kassadin.escape: While Kassadin R Riftwalk is down, you have an opportunity to engage. If Kassadin E Force Pulse is down too, you have less reason to worry about its slow; focus your damage after Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is down as well. When chasing, watch Kassadin’s mana to see if he can cast Kassadin R Riftwalk again.
Kassadin.fight: When Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield is down, slow Kassadin with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin makes Kassadin E Force Pulse come back sooner, so only use abilities when trading.
Kassadin.laning: When hitting Kassadin with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, position so the minion wave won’t block it.
Kassadin.phase: In the late game, watch for Kassadin flanking from behind, don’t stand alone, and look to deal area damage in teamfights.
Kassadin.teamfight: As your team engages, hit several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land it alongside empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Watch for Kassadin R Riftwalk’s engage and save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool for the counterattack. Don’t chase just one enemy; hit clustered enemies to increase the healing from Vladimir R Hemoplague.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere’s shield absorbs magic poke, so deal damage while the shield is down. Kassadin E Force Pulse slows you; use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits. Don’t chase recklessly while Kassadin R Riftwalk is available.

Leblanc.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. LeBlanc deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance. If you need to survive LeBlanc’s burst engage, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Leblanc.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When LeBlanc goes in, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood from an angle that isn’t blocked by minions to slow her, then follow with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Dodge LeBlanc’s counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you.
Leblanc.escape: Right after baiting out LeBlanc W Distortion, you have an opportunity to close the distance, but first confirm that the short window to return has ended or she has already used her return before moving in. After dodging LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains or moving beyond the chain’s range, you can counterattack without worrying about the root. If the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice remains, back away first to give it time to disappear.
Leblanc.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When LeBlanc enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Close the distance after LeBlanc W Distortion’s return expires or has already been used. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge LeBlanc’s counterattack instead of using it first.
Leblanc.laning: When your health is low, don’t recklessly push the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; recover first with Vladimir Q Transfusion. Alert your team immediately if LeBlanc disappears from mid lane vision.
Leblanc.phase: As Vladimir’s items stack up, his health and ability power both increase, so deal area damage in late-game teamfights.
Leblanc.teamfight: As your team engages, hit several clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with them. Charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood as you enter, land it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, then use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when their counterattack comes in.
Leblanc.watch: When the mark from LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice is on you, back away and wait for it to disappear. LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains roots you after it stays connected, so if it hits, immediately move beyond the chain’s range. If you need to dodge the incoming chain, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.

Lux.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Lux’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Lux enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply a slow and cast it. Follow with empowered Q, and catch Lux Q Light Binding with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits. E can be blocked by enemy units in front, so don’t cast it through the minion wave.
Lux.escape: The moment after Lux Q Light Binding misses is an opportunity to engage. Lux has no ability to create distance on her own, so approach from a bush or the side to close the gap.
Lux.fight: Close the distance after dodging Lux Q Light Binding or erasing it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Lux enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Q.
Lux.laning: Early on, prioritize CS near your turret, using Vladimir Q Transfusion to last-hit and heal. Lux Q Light Binding roots the first two enemies it hits, so don’t stand in line with an ally.
Lux.phase: In the late game, use your accumulated health and ability power to focus on damaging several enemies in teamfights.
Lux.teamfight: Don’t approach clustered in one place with your allies, so Lux E Lucent Singularity doesn’t impede all of you together. Hit several enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E, then use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when their counterattack comes in.
Lux.watch: If you’re hit by Lux Q Light Binding, you’re likely to take her follow-up abilities too, so bait it out and dodge it. If it’s about to hit, erase the incoming ability with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. After taking a Lux ability, create distance to avoid her basic attack that detonates the Illumination mark. Move sideways if you see the aim line for Lux R Final Spark.

Malzahar.build: Early on, survive with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Malzahar’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about choices that greatly increase health alone.
Malzahar.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. Break Malzahar P Void Shift first, then charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood from a position where minions won’t block it, slow him, and land empowered Q. Dodge Malzahar’s counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it reaches you.
Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so when Malzahar Q Call of the Void and Malzahar R Nether Grasp are down, you have an opportunity to close the distance. Go in when the summons from Malzahar W Void Swarm have disappeared or haven’t spawned yet, and Malzahar P Void Shift has been stripped away. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge the counterattack.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with a light ability before fighting. Use minions to charge Vladimir Q Transfusion twice. When Malzahar enters range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow him, then land empowered Q. Keep your distance while Malzahar’s crowd control is available, and don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first for a trade.
Malzahar.laning: If Malzahar E Malefic Visions is on the wave, move away from the minions, and don’t recklessly push with Vladimir E Tides of Blood when your health is low. If Malzahar pushes the lane and Malzahar P Void Shift is down, look for an opportunity to pressure him with your jungler.
Malzahar.phase: Vladimir also gets stronger with items in the late game, but Malzahar’s growth stacks also build up, so don’t give him a chance to catch you alone.
Malzahar.teamfight: If Malzahar W Void Swarm’s summons are already out, clear them with area abilities. Engage when Malzahar R Nether Grasp has been used on your team’s engage champion and Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. Hit several clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in with your team while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E, then dodge the counterattack with W when it comes in.
Malzahar.watch: If you stand beside a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions, the damage can transfer to you when the minion dies, so move away. Malzahar Q Call of the Void silences, so move outside the line between the portals. While Malzahar R Nether Grasp is available, don’t go alone into an area without vision. If Malzahar R Nether Grasp has already suppressed you, Vladimir W Sanguine Pool can’t free you.

Mel.build: Start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for your boots. Mel’s main damage is magic, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Mel.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Mel W Rebuttal is down, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land empowered Q. E can be blocked by minions in front, so don’t cast it through the wave. Dodge Mel E Solar Snare with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.
Mel.escape: Mel has no mobility abilities, so after Mel E Solar Snare and Mel W Rebuttal are down, you have an opportunity to close the distance. Go in while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready, and use W to dodge when the counterattack comes in.
Mel.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered version. When Mel enters range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Q. Use E after Mel W Rebuttal is down, and save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you need to dodge Mel E Solar Snare or a counterattack.
Mel.laning: Once you can clear the wave quickly with E, push the lane to limit Mel’s time to stack Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Mel.phase: Mel R Golden Eclipse’s growth is permanent, putting you at a greater disadvantage over time, so once you’ve grown safely, limit the time Mel has to stack it.
Mel.teamfight: As your team engages, hit several enemies, including Mel, with Vladimir R Hemoplague. Go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes in, and also to dodge Mel E Solar Snare just before it hits you. If you’ve taken Mel’s poke several times, watch out for Overwhelm stacks and the finisher from Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Mel.watch: Mel E Solar Snare roots you if you’re hit in the center, and Mel Q Radiant Volley can follow, so sidestep it. If you’ve been hit several times by Mel and Overwhelm has stacked up, watch out for an execution and Mel R Golden Eclipse, which has no range limit, even if you still have health remaining.

Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, and Vladimir has low armor, so start with Cloth Armor to survive, then buy Plated Steelcaps. If Naafiri is diving onto Vladimir, buy Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. If fights drag on because of the healing from Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and E Eviscerate, build resistances first, then consider Morellonomicon.
Naafiri.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Naafiri engages, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, fire it to apply the slow, then land the empowered Q. In teamfights, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then engage while charging E and land the empowered Q and E. When the counterattack comes, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool while keeping E charged.
Naafiri.escape: Don’t engage just because Naafiri has used only one Q Darkin Daggers. Look for a window after Naafiri has also used E Eviscerate and before R Hounds’ Pursuit comes back up. Keep Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit’s slow and dash in mind, and don’t spend Vladimir W Sanguine Pool on a trade before the engage.
Naafiri.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Naafiri comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land the empowered Q. Right after Naafiri E Eviscerate revives her pack, clear it with an area ability such as Vladimir E Tides of Blood and counterattack. Don’t use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it for when the counterattack comes after Naafiri engages.
Naafiri.laning: Early on, last-hit and poke with Vladimir Q Transfusion from behind the minion line, and don’t give Naafiri an angle to close in with E Eviscerate. Farm incoming waves near your turret, and when health has been depleted, heal with Q before trying to push hard with Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Naafiri’s pack clears waves, so don’t try to freeze the lane completely.
Naafiri.phase: Your contribution in fights increases after Vladimir R Hemoplague becomes available and you complete your first core item, but Naafiri’s mid-game roams are the most dangerous, so maintain broad vision coverage. Late game, group with your team and take front-to-front teamfights; area damage will clear Naafiri’s pack and reduce its damage output.
Naafiri.teamfight: When your team engages, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and deal area damage where opponents are grouped. Fight grouped with your team so Naafiri can’t get an angle onto your backline, and use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to absorb the focus fire. Right after an ally dies, Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit may be used again, so retreat immediately to avoid getting picked off in succession.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once and applies a bleed, create distance until the bleed ends so you don’t get hit by the second Q. Naafiri R Hounds’ Pursuit locks onto a champion and dashes to them, so don’t travel alone while Naafiri has R. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack makes her untargetable, don’t use Vladimir Q Transfusion; wait until it ends.

Neeko.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Neeko’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs roots you and Neeko R Pop Blossom follows, prioritize tenacity.
Neeko.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Neeko engages, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In fights where several enemies are grouped, hit them first with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land it with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack comes.
Neeko.escape: The moment after Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to trade.
Neeko.fight: When Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare a trade. When Neeko comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land an empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you can dodge Neeko’s counterattack.
Neeko.laning: Vladimir E Tides of Blood costs health, so don’t spam it to farm when health has been depleted. If minions are packed together, Vladimir E Tides of Blood may not reach Neeko, so don’t fire it through the wave.
Neeko.phase: Late game, use your accumulated health and ability power to damage multiple enemies in teamfights.
Neeko.teamfight: Hit multiple grouped enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team’s engage. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge the enemy counterattack. Aim area damage at grouped enemies instead of chasing one target for a long time.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is more threatening after it hits the first target, so don’t stand in a line behind minions or overlap with an ally. If Neeko approaches while disguised, you may not see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so create distance as soon as a suspicious opponent gets close. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Neeko E Tangle-Barbs hits.

Orianna.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Orianna’s main damage is magic and Vladimir has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Later, health also contributes to damage through Vladimir P Crimson Pact.
Orianna.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered attack. After Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood from an angle where minions won’t block it, land the slow, then follow with an empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you can dodge Orianna’s counterattack.
Orianna.escape: Close the distance when Orianna’s ball is far away and you’re outside the danger area of Orianna R Command: Shockwave. Orianna has no ability to create distance herself, so once you’re close, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land Vladimir Q Transfusion. When Orianna R Command: Shockwave is coming, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.
Orianna.fight: The moment after Orianna uses Q Command: Attack to send the ball away from herself is your chance to trade. Approach while avoiding the area around the ball, then hit Orianna with an empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion you prepared on minions. Take short trades with abilities rather than exchanging basic attacks against Orianna’s empowered basic attacks.
Orianna.laning: Farm incoming waves near your turret, and don’t try to push hard with Vladimir E Tides of Blood when health has been depleted. After restoring health through healing, push the lane when you have room to clear the wave, then establish vision or join a fight in another lane.
Orianna.phase: Late game, use your accumulated health and ability power to damage multiple enemies in teamfights.
Orianna.teamfight: Check Orianna’s ball position and avoid places where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can pull you in. When the enemy team is grouped, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then go in with your team as they engage, charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood as you enter. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then dodge the counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when it comes.
Orianna.watch: Position yourself based on where the ball moves with Orianna Q Command: Attack. Near the ball, you can be pulled in by Orianna R Command: Shockwave, so dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits. Also avoid fights where you take repeated empowered basic attacks from Orianna P Clockwork Windup.

Ryze.build: Ryze deals mostly magic damage and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Ryze.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Ryze comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to apply a slow, then land the empowered Q. Minions in front can block E, so don’t fire it through the wave. Dodge Ryze’s counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Ryze.escape: While Ryze R Realm Warp is down, he can’t move with his ultimate, so look for an opportunity to engage. If Ryze E Spell Flux’s mark isn’t on you or Ryze W Rune Prison is down, going in reduces the risk of being rooted. Before engaging, check that Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available.
Ryze.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Ryze comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow him, then land the empowered Q. Try to trade after dodging Ryze E Spell Flux’s mark or when Ryze W Rune Prison is down. Don’t spend Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it to dodge the counterattack.
Ryze.laning: Ryze also lacks mana and damage early on, so trade when you can time Vladimir Q Transfusion’s empowered cast to pressure his scaling.
Ryze.phase: From here, use Vladimir’s strength as his items stack to push the lane and join fights.
Ryze.teamfight: When the enemy team is grouped, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team’s engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, land it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, and dodge the counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when it comes. If Ryze E Spell Flux marks you, separate from allies to prevent the damage from spreading around you.
Ryze.watch: Prioritize dodging the mark from Ryze E Spell Flux. If marked, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage, so if you’re hit, separate from allies and keep your distance until the mark disappears. Dodge Ryze W Rune Prison that follows the mark with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.

Sylas.build: Sylas deals mostly magic damage and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Sylas.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Sylas approaches, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow him, then land the empowered Q. If Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s chain comes at you, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.
Sylas.escape: Dodge the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. Look for an opening while Sylas E is unavailable and before its cooldown finishes, but don’t go deep right away if Sylas W Kingslayer is still available.
Sylas.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Sylas comes into range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land the empowered Q. The window before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct comes back is an opportunity to engage, but account for the possibility of an escape if Sylas W Kingslayer is still available.
Sylas.laning: Early on, last-hit with Vladimir Q Transfusion and scale safely near your turret.
Sylas.teamfight: Hit Sylas and several nearby enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team’s engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E, and use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool against Sylas E Abscond / Abduct’s chain or focused counterattacks.
Sylas.watch: Be more wary of the second chain from Sylas E Abscond / Abduct than the first dash. Dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the chain hits, and if Sylas Q Chain Lash grazes you, move out of the crossing point where it explodes after a delay.

Syndra.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle to survive and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Syndra’s main damage, but also consider health to withstand the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, if Syndra comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood to slow her, then land the empowered Q. Minions can block E’s wave, so don’t fire it through the wave.
Syndra.escape: Syndra has no mobility, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak is her only self-peel, so the moment after she uses E is your chance to engage. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Syndra’s crowd control hits, and don’t force an engage during its long cooldown.
Syndra.fight: Don’t force fights early; close the distance after Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Syndra comes into range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land the empowered Q.
Syndra.laning: Get boots early so you can walk out of the indicated areas for Syndra Q Dark Sphere, Syndra W Force of Will, and Syndra E Scatter the Weak.
Syndra.phase: As your items stack, you grow stronger, so clear the lane and establish vision or join fights, then deal area damage in mid-to-late-game teamfights.
Syndra.teamfight: Avoid areas covered by multiple Syndra Q Dark Spheres, and engage when Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available. When the enemy team is grouped, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team as they engage, charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood as you enter. Land empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and E, then dodge the counterattack with W when it comes.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push it and stun you, so get out of the sphere’s line. If you can’t dodge an incoming sphere, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits. Move away from areas covered by multiple Syndra Q Dark Spheres, where Syndra R Unleashed Power is also dangerous.

Talon.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor to survive and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Talon deals physical damage, so build armor first, but also get health to withstand lethality. If Talon often dives Vladimir, get Zhonya's Hourglass early.
Talon.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Talon approaches, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit him with the slow, then land the empowered Q. In a dense wave, E may not reach Talon, so don’t fire it through the minions. Dodge Talon’s counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when it comes.
Talon.escape: Right after you make Talon use Q Noxian Diplomacy, use the window while that mobility ability is down to close the distance. If you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is also down, use the window when stealth can’t help him escape to counterattack. Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has a long cooldown, so don’t use it first when starting a trade.
Talon.fight: The moment after Talon uses Q Noxian Diplomacy is your chance to close the distance and counterattack. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered Q. When Talon comes into range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then land the empowered Q. You can fight more aggressively once you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault is down.
Talon.laning: If Talon roams, share his position and place vision along jungle paths.
Talon.phase: Talon’s influence falls off late game while Vladimir grows stronger as his items stack, so look for fights where you can group with your team.
Talon.teamfight: When the enemy team is grouped, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and go in with your team’s engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land it with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion, then dodge the counterattack with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when it comes. If Talon dives your backline, respond as a group with your team and counterattack after Talon R Shadow Assault is down.
Talon.watch: Getting hit by both the outgoing and returning parts of Talon W Rake makes it easier for him to trigger Talon P Blade's End. If the first hit lands, move out of the return path; if it’s hard to dodge, use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the blades hit. While Talon R Shadow Assault is available, he can rely on stealth to escape, so don’t chase recklessly.

TwistedFate.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Twisted Fate deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
TwistedFate.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Twisted Fate approaches, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit him with the slow, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is flying toward you, dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card is used is your chance to move in.
TwistedFate.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Twisted Fate comes into range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Keep your distance while he holds a gold card, then move in after he uses it.
TwistedFate.laning: When health has been lost, recover with Vladimir Q Transfusion first instead of recklessly pushing the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood.
TwistedFate.phase: From mid game onward, clear the wave, establish vision, and join fights while keeping an eye on Twisted Fate R Destiny roams.
TwistedFate.teamfight: When Twisted Fate W Pick a Card's gold card has been used and Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available, follow your team's engage. Hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood as you dive in, then deal damage with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion and Vladimir E Tides of Blood. Dodge when the counterattack focuses on you with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a gold card, stay outside his basic attack range, then dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the card hits.

Veigar.build: Early on, start with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Veigar deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Veigar.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Veigar comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood from a position where minions won't block it, slow him, then follow with the empowered Q. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to respond to Veigar E Event Horizon.
Veigar.escape: Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, you have a chance to close the distance.
Veigar.fight: Early on, don't overextend while Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is unavailable or difficult to use. Pressure Veigar after Veigar E Event Horizon is down. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it, then when Veigar comes into range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land the empowered Q.
Veigar.laning: Secure last hits with Vladimir Q Transfusion, and don't let Veigar Q Baleful Strike hit you for free and give him stacking growth. Vladimir E Tides of Blood costs health, so don't spam it to farm when health has been lost. Veigar is weak early, so pressure him safely, but avoid positions near the front of the lane where the enemy jungler can catch you.
Veigar.phase: Veigar's stacks are permanent, so be more wary of his combo as the game goes on.
Veigar.teamfight: Check Veigar's position and whether Veigar E Event Horizon has been used. When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is available, follow your team's engage. Hit multiple clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague, then dive in while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land empowered Q and E. Use W to dodge when the counterattack focuses on you, and attack clustered enemies together instead of chasing Veigar alone.
Veigar.watch: Veigar E Event Horizon stuns you when you cross its edge, so if you're trapped inside, move around within it instead of running toward the edge. If health is below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on the target's missing health.

Vex.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Vex deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, fire it with the slow, then follow with the empowered Q. Dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before Vex's counterattack hits.
Vex.escape: Make sure Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear has also been used before moving in.
Vex.fight: Look for an opening when Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear has been used on the wave or to poke, and Vex W Personal Space's shield is down. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it, then when Vex comes into range, slow her with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land the empowered Q. Don't use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool, which has a long cooldown, first in a trade; save it for Vex's counterattack.
Vex.laning: E can be blocked by enemy units in front, so don't have the wave between you and Vex when you try to hit her.
Vex.phase: In the mid to late game, focus on pushing the wave and joining your team's fights to deal area damage instead of chasing kills.
Vex.teamfight: Have low-health allies move out of Vex's range first so Vex R Shadow Surge can't start a chain of dashes with a first kill. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack focuses on you, and target clustered enemies instead of chasing one.
Vex.watch: Don't move in close while Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready. Vex E Looming Darkness gets wider the farther it travels, so when you're in range, take a short sidestep instead of retreating far backward.
