If you're hit by Vex R Shadow Surge, she will soon dash in, so move toward your allies. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before a projectile or crowd control reaches you.

Viktor.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Viktor's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for your boots and prioritize magic resistance.
Viktor.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. When Viktor comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, fire it with the slow, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave its area and stop trading.
Viktor.escape: Viktor has no dash to create distance, so after dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, you have a chance to close the gap. When engaging, don't use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it to dodge Viktor's counterattack.
Viktor.fight: After dodging Viktor W Gravity Field, trade by timing the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion you've prepared on minions to hit Viktor. Viktor can gain a shield and movement speed from Viktor Q Siphon Power, so once you've closed the distance, stick to him with the slow from Vladimir E Tides of Blood.
Viktor.laning: When Viktor E Hextech Ray is aimed at the wave, don't stand in line with the minions. When health has been reduced, recover with Vladimir Q Transfusion before pushing the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood.
Viktor.phase: Viktor's growth from Viktor P Glorious Evolution is permanent, making him harder to deal with as time passes. Make use of your early opportunities, and don't assume the same engage angle will keep working later.
Viktor.teamfight: When the enemy team is clustered, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and follow your team's engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack focuses on you. Don't stay inside Viktor W Gravity Field, and target clustered enemies.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray is a straight-line ability, so don't stand in line with the wave; step to the side to dodge it. Viktor W Gravity Field stuns you if you stay inside, so leave as soon as it's placed and don't continue trading in it.

Xerath.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Xerath deals mostly magic damage, and Vladimir has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Xerath.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered attack. When Xerath comes into range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, slow him, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If minions are tightly packed, they can block Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so don't fire it with the wave between you and Xerath.
Xerath.escape: The moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your chance to engage. Xerath has no mobility, so close the distance then, but save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool until you need to dodge his counterattack.
Xerath.fight: Close the distance while dodging to the side as Xerath charges Xerath Q Arcanopulse. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, look to trade with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion you've prepared.
Xerath.laning: Early on, secure last hits near your turret with Vladimir Q Transfusion and scale while dodging Xerath's heavy damage. When health has been reduced, recover first with Vladimir Q Transfusion instead of recklessly pushing the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood. After Xerath has spent a lot of mana, push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Once you have more items in the mid to late game, focus on damaging multiple enemies in teamfights.
Xerath.teamfight: When the enemy team is clustered, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and follow your team's engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then deal damage with it and empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack focuses on you. If Xerath R Rite of the Arcane is visible, look for a chance to engage on him while he can't move.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge to the side. If you're hit by Xerath E Shocking Orb's stun, you're likely to take follow-up damage, so avoid the orb with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits.

Yasuo.build: Early on, start with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo's main damage is physical, and Vladimir has relatively low armor, so build armor first. If you need to withstand Yasuo's repeated engages, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Yasuo.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast. Once Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield is gone and you've dodged the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, slow him, then land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In a dense minion wave, minions can block Vladimir E Tides of Blood, so line up your shot first.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest is your chance to engage. Don't chase far just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade is down; target him with your team's crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer's shield first with light poke, then trade seriously once the shield is gone. Right after dodging the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest, he won't have a knock-up for a while, giving you a chance to close the distance. Don't use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool first; save it to dodge Yasuo's counterattack.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so a thin wave pushes toward your side of the lane; this limits the minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to approach.
Yasuo.teamfight: When the enemy team is clustered, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and follow your team's engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack focuses on you. Watch for the knock-up from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and target clustered enemies instead of chasing one for too long.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo has landed Yasuo Q Steel Tempest twice, watch for the knock-up on his next attack and dodge to the side, out of its line. If you're knocked up, he can follow with Yasuo R Last Breath, so dodge with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the attack hits. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to approach, so don't give him room between the minions.

Yone.build: Yone deals both physical and magic damage, so don't rely on building just one type of resistance. Yone W Spirit Cleave deals damage based on your maximum health, so be wary of relying on stacking health alone. If Yone's repeated engages are a threat, get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier and alternate it with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool.
Yone.combo: In lane, use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when Yone approaches, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit him with the slow, and follow with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. In teamfights, use Vladimir R Hemoplague on clustered enemies first, then land Vladimir E Tides of Blood and empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion as your allies engage. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when the counterattack focuses on you.
Yone.escape: Don't engage just because Yone Q Mortal Steel is down. Look for an opening after the tornado stacks disappear, Yone has used Yone E Soul Unbound, and Yone R Fate Sealed is still down. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool as you engage to handle Yone's next crowd control.
Yone.fight: Look to trade after Yone Q Mortal Steel's tornado stacks disappear and Yone has used Yone E Soul Unbound. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it, then when Yone comes into range, slow him with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge crowd control from his counterattack.
Yone.laning: Early on, watch Yone Q Mortal Steel's stacks, keep your distance, and secure last hits with Vladimir Q Transfusion. While Yone has a gust ready, don't step forward and force CS; play safe near your turret. When health has been reduced, pushing the wave recklessly with Vladimir E Tides of Blood gives him an opening to engage, so recover first with Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Yone.phase: Your impact in fights grows from mid game onward once you have Vladimir R Hemoplague and your first core item, so clear the wave, then help establish vision or join fights in other lanes. In the late game, Vladimir deals more teamfight damage as his health and ability power grow, so look for fights coordinated with your allies instead of engaging alone recklessly.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Yone W Spirit Cleave, and check your back line, since Yone R Fate Sealed moves him behind the last champion along its path. When Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready, hit clustered enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and follow your team's engage.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions, his gust engage is ready, so keep your distance until the stacks disappear. Yone can engage with Yone E Soul Unbound, then catch you with Yone Q Mortal Steel or Yone R Fate Sealed, so use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the crowd control hits. Yone W Spirit Cleave grants a shield and deals damage based on your maximum health, so leave its telegraphed area.

Zed.build: Zed's main damage is physical, and Vladimir has relatively low armor, so build armor first with Cloth Armor early. Choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots and get Zhonya's Hourglass earlier to withstand Zed's engage. Zed P Contempt for the Weak deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Zed.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice, then when Zed W Living Shadow is down, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, slow him, and land the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If you use Vladimir Q Transfusion first, Vladimir E Tides of Blood can miss after Zed backs away. Respond with Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when Zed counterattacks.
Zed.escape: The chance to move in and fight comes when Zed W Living Shadow disappears or after Zed has already switched positions with the shadow. It's even better if Zed R Death Mark is still down, but check before engaging because he can escape with his remaining mobility if only one mobility ability is down. Dodge the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash by moving away from the shadow's position.
Zed.fight: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare an empowered cast, then trade when Zed W Living Shadow is down. Charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood first to slow him, then follow with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool for Zed's counterattack.
Zed.laning: Vladimir E Tides of Blood costs health, so don't spam it to push the wave when your health is low. If you need healing, look for a chance to hit the enemy champion with Vladimir Q Transfusion, and don't stay too far forward for long or you'll give Zed an opening to engage.
Zed.phase: In the late game, group with your allies and make the most of Vladimir's area damage in teamfights.
Zed.teamfight: When the enemy team is clustered, hit multiple enemies with Vladimir R Hemoplague and follow your team's engage. Approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood, then use it with empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool when Zed's counterattack focuses on you. Hit clustered enemies instead of chasing one deep, increasing the healing from Vladimir R Hemoplague.
Zed.watch: Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow as you move to avoid the slow from Zed E Shadow Slash cast from the shadow. You can erase a flying Zed Q Razor Shuriken by using Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before it hits, but its cooldown is long, so don't spend it on a light trade. When Zed engages with Zed R Death Mark, watch for the damage that continues until the mark detonates.

Zoe.build: Early on, use a Null-Magic Mantle to withstand Zoe’s main source of magic damage, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. The first resistance Vladimir should build is magic resistance. However, resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so prioritize dodging the bubble.
Zoe.combo: Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to prepare its empowered timing. When Zoe comes within range, charge Vladimir E Tides of Blood, hit her to apply the slow, then use the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion. If Zoe moves with Zoe R Portal Jump, look to hit her as she returns to her starting point.
Zoe.escape: The moment Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down is your chance to engage. If Zoe uses Zoe R Portal Jump, aim for the starting point where she must return.
Zoe.fight: Don’t rush for a kill early; look to trade after Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down. Use Vladimir Q Transfusion on minions twice to empower it, then, from an angle where minions won’t block it, slow Zoe with Vladimir E Tides of Blood and follow up with the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Zoe.laning: When health has been reduced, don’t recklessly push the wave with Vladimir E Tides of Blood; heal first with Vladimir Q Transfusion. Save Vladimir W Sanguine Pool to dodge Zoe’s bubble and star instead of using it early in a trade.
Zoe.phase: In the mid to late game, as you build items, focus on dealing damage to multiple enemies in team fights.
Zoe.teamfight: When Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble is down and Vladimir W Sanguine Pool is ready, follow your team’s engage. Use Vladimir R Hemoplague to cover as many grouped enemies as possible, then approach while charging Vladimir E Tides of Blood and hit them alongside the empowered Vladimir Q Transfusion.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you’ll fall asleep a moment later, making it easy for Zoe Q Paddle Star! to hit too. Use Vladimir W Sanguine Pool just before the bubble reaches you. If it already hit, move behind a wall or an ally before the sleep triggers. Even a bubble that misses leaves a trap, so watch narrow paths and bush entrances without vision.
